proposals.before: Several hundred people in the capital were killed by the earthquake, and inside the Gate of Virtuous Clarity the head of a stone dragon was shaken loose; the learned took stone to be the dynastic surname of the house—a dire omen indeed.
proposals.after: Several hundred people in the capital were killed by lightning, and inside the Gate of Virtuous Clarity the head of a stone dragon was shaken loose; the learned took stone to be the dynastic surname of the house—a dire omen indeed.
proposals.reason: After the thunderstorm in the prior unit, 震死者 and 震落 refer to lightning strikes, not an earthquake.

proposals.before: At that time several hundred people in the capital were killed by the quake; inside the Gate of Virtuous Clarity the head of a stone dragon fell from the shock, and those who understood such things held that stone was the dynastic surname—surely a most inauspicious sign.
proposals.after: At that time several hundred people in the capital were killed by the lightning strike; inside the Gate of Virtuous Clarity the head of a stone dragon fell from the shock, and those who understood such things held that stone was the dynastic surname—surely a most inauspicious sign.
proposals.reason: 震 in this thunderstorm context means struck by lightning rather than an earthquake.

proposals.before: On jiayin, Jia Wei, Recorder of the Heir Apparent with edict-drafting duties, became Director of the Bureau of Household Registers while retaining his drafting post.
proposals.after: On jiayin, Jia Wei, Imperial Diarist and edict drafter, became Director of the Bureau of Household Registers while retaining his drafting post.
proposals.reason: 起居郎 is the imperial diarist, not an office of the Heir Apparent.

proposals.before: On jiayin, Jia Wei, Recorder of the Heir Apparent and drafter of edicts, was made Director of the Bureau of Household Registers and continued as drafter of edicts.
proposals.after: On jiayin, Jia Wei, Imperial Diarist and drafter of edicts, was made Director of the Bureau of Household Registers and continued as drafter of edicts.
proposals.reason: 起居郎 should not be rendered as Recorder of the Heir Apparent.

decisions.reason: The immediately preceding 大雷雨 controls the sense of 震死: hundreds were killed by lightning, not by a separate earthquake.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 會大雷雨……都下震死者數百人

decisions.reason: In the thunderstorm context, 震死 means killed by lightning; the paired literal field must carry the same meaning.
起居郎 was a court diarist who recorded imperial activity, not a recorder attached to the heir apparent.
The literal field contains the same office mistranslation and should render 起居郎 as Imperial Diarist.
